jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Agentic Search) - Web Rendering Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on production backend or infrastructure systems Expert in several of the following areas: browser rendering; Chromium rendering pipeline (DOM, Layout, Paint, Compositing); JavaScript execution inside browsers and page readiness/render lifecycle; headless browser execution and browser instrumentation; Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP); Playwright/Puppeteer/Selenium or similar frameworks; modern web applications (React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, SPA/PWA, SSR/CSR/streaming); resource loading, lazy loading, and modern JavaScript bundles
